title: Big Numbers
summary: Place value up to lakhs, Indian and international commas, number names, and adding and multiplying larger numbers.

cbse.chapter: Maths Mela (2025) Ch 1: We the Travellers 1
Maths Mela (2025) Ch 4: We the Travellers 2
Maths Mela (2025) Ch 6: The Dairy Farm

objectives: I can read and write numbers up to 9,99,999.
I can use Indian and international commas.
I can add, subtract and multiply bigger numbers.
misconceptions: A longer number is always bigger, even with leading zeros.
1 lakh is the same as 1 million.
The 5 in 5,000 and the 5 in 50 are worth the same.
